keyEvents.text: Illia Zabarnyi (Paris Saint Germain) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 1, Troyes 0. Illia Zabarnyi (Paris Saint Germain) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Senny Mayulu with a cross following a corner.
First Half ends, Paris Saint Germain 1, Troyes 0.
Second Half begins Paris Saint Germain 1, Troyes 0.
Substitution, Troyes. Hugo Picard replaces Kandet Diawara.
Substitution, Troyes. Jérémy Le Douaron replaces Renaud Ripart.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. João Neves replaces Mika Godts.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Quentin Ndjantou replaces Ferran Torres.
Substitution, Troyes. Idrissa Soukouna replaces Merwan Ifnaoui.
Substitution, Troyes. Yvann Titi replaces Ismaël Boura.
Jérémy Le Douaron (Troyes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Troyes. Timothé Nkada replaces Mouhamed Diop.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Dro Fernández replaces Senny Mayulu.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Beraldo replaces Fabián Ruiz.
Antoine Mille (Troyes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
